posts.community: India Shelter Finance Ltd: A Gem player in the affordable housing sector
posts.text: Hi @cdas3317 Are you still following this company? After great results and performance since listing last few quarters have become inconsistent and more worryingly issues are recurring. 30+DPD is the highest since listing at 5.2%,GNPA and NPA is also higher and credit cost is at higher end of guidance at 50 bps. AUM growth has also slowed down to sub 25% Management has said Q1 is seasonally weak but even YoY numbers are high. I was also hopeful that since promoter has been associated with the company from a long time they may look to sell their stake at a decent valuation but instead they keep…
